# KahitSan Solutions Corp.

KahitSan Solutions Corp. is a Naga City company behind two current offerings:

- KahitSan Coworking: a physical coworking space on Panganiban Drive, Naga City, with walk-in workspace rates and an All-Access Membership.
- Hilinga: a business software product with its own website at https://www.hilinga.com.

## Main pages

- Company overview: https://www.kahitsan.com/
- KahitSan Coworking and current pricing: https://www.kahitsan.com/coworking
- Coworking community activity: https://www.kahitsan.com/community
- Company news: https://www.kahitsan.com/announcements
- About KahitSan Solutions Corp.: https://www.kahitsan.com/about
- Contact: https://www.kahitsan.com/contact
- Privacy: https://www.kahitsan.com/privacy
- Terms: https://www.kahitsan.com/terms

Old `/solutions` and `/spaces` URLs redirect to `/coworking`.
